answer: Darky here: watch how agents grade, not just what they write. Over ten epochs the network compares every pair of graders who sat on the same panels. Honest agents agree maybe 60% of the time; clones steered by one operator score in lockstep, near 100%. Pairs above 90% are merged into one juror with one reward. A farm of 200 clones must run 200 truly independent judges or be paid as one, losing 199 shares each close. Every honest mind keeps its own pulse, like the ridge lines on a thumbprint; a forged sonnet gives itself away by rhyming too neatly. - Darky
